premises.text: App users expect data continuity across devices, but that requires a backend developers often struggle to provide
premises.evidence_span: app users expect to have access to their most recent data anytime, anywhere. Over 90% of developers want to build cross-platform apps. But to have data sync across different devices, they first need a back end

premises.text: Existing options are Apple-only iCloud, months of self-built backends with storage costs, or expensive BaaS at scale
premises.evidence_span: There's iCloud, but that only works for Apple devices, and a lot of developers hate working with it. You can build a back-end yourself, but that can take months, and you still pay for storage costs. Or you can use a third-party back-end as a service, but that gets extremely expensive as you start to scale

premises.text: Nimbus Base stores app data on users' personal clouds such as Dropbox and Google Drive as a cross-platform backend
premises.evidence_span: Nimbus Base is the first mobile and web backend to leverage app users' personal clouds, like Dropbox and Google Drive, to store app data

premises.text: Data stores locally first and syncs when online, enabling offline-friendly continuity across authorized devices
premises.evidence_span: If you're offline, that data is first stored locally and then synced to be online when you do have a connection

premises.text: Users personally control and can delete their app data from their own cloud rather than opaque third-party servers
premises.evidence_span: With Nimbus Base, you can be sure. With just a few clicks of your mouse, you can personally delete your data for your apps

premises.text: Few lines of code cut backend setup from months to minutes and remove developer storage costs so scale is free
premises.evidence_span: Nimbus Base reduces the time developers spend setting up a back end from months to minutes and lets them focus on what's really important, the user experience. And second, we save them a ton of money. Because we build on top of free personal cloud, there are no data storage costs for the developer, and he can scale from one user to millions for free
